resources.string: Chimahon OCR Fork: floating original-text OCR and dictionary lookup (Android 14+). Tap the floating OCR button to capture the underlying app window while Google Scroll and Translate remains active. Tap original text for definitions; tap well away from text or Close OCR to leave. Long-press the floating button to hide it; open Screen OCR in Chimahon OCR Fork to restore it. Normal screen taps and scrolling are not intercepted. Captures are held in memory; the selected OCR engine may use the network. Disable this service here to stop.
